title: Wear app: With watch face double-tap setting "calculator percentage" set to "OFF", calculator always uses 0%
body:
**AndroidAPS 3.0.0.2-dev-k**
**Build:** ff46cbf195 2022.05.12
**Flavor**: Fullrelease

**Watch**: Samsung Galaxy Watch4 44mm
**Wear App**: FF46CBF195

**Problem description:**

With watch face double-tap setting "calculator percentage" set to "OFF", calculator always uses 0% without offering the user to change percentage. Expected behavior: using AAPS default percentage.

With this setting to "ON" it is using the default value synced from AAPS, for user to optionally change)
